Read-only adversarial review of branch feat/play-store-qol vs bookiro/main in /home/ck3k/Work/wt-qol (Android Compose app). Three features: (1) a new Home tab, (2) a library sort-sheet + list redesign, (3) a shared circular sleep-timer sheet + audio progress persistence fix. Use `git diff bookiro/main..HEAD` and read the files.

Key new/changed code:
- app/src/main/java/com/bookrio/app/ui/HomeScreen.kt, HomeViewModel.kt; MainActivity.kt (bottom nav + nav graph); Navigation.kt; app/src/main/res/values*/strings.xml.
- library/src/main/java/com/bookrio/library/ui/LibraryScreen.kt; viewmodel/LibraryViewModel.kt; sort/LibrarySorter.kt; sort/ResumeSelector.kt; core/.../LibrarySortMode.kt; core/.../BookModels.kt (LibraryViewType); data/.../prefs/UserPreferencesRepository.kt.
- designsystem/.../components/SleepTimerSheet.kt; player/.../ui/PlayerScreen.kt; player/.../service/AudiobookPlaybackService.kt + AudioProgressRow.kt; podcast/.../ui/PodcastPlayerScreen.kt; podcast/.../playback/PodcastPlaybackService.kt.

Focus on concrete defects only (file:line + severity + fix):
1. Crashes / null-safety: HomeViewModel combines DAOs; HomeScreen formatting; library empty/loading; sleep dial math (angle→minutes, clamp 1..120, dead zone); division by zero.
2. Correctness: is the multi-book Continue actually correct (ResumeSelector max=Int.MAX_VALUE, ordering, dedupe)? Does the newest-episodes DAO query compile/return sane data? Does LibrarySortMode.from migration preserve old prefs? Does LibraryViewType.SHELF removal break any stored value?
3. Regressions: removed `SortRail`/`toggleSortDirection` callers; `sectionLabels` signature change; any other caller of changed APIs; unused string resources (lib_sort_shelf removed?).
4. The audio progress fix: does it truly preserve positionMs/chapter fields without wiping other columns? Any REPLACE/upsert hazard?
5. Anything that would break the Play-store release build (:app:assembleRelease) rather than just debug.

Run `./gradlew :library:testDebugUnitTest :player:testDebugUnitTest :app:assembleDebug` if useful. Do NOT modify files. Output a prioritized findings list with file:line, or an explicit 'no blocking issues' if none.
